scenarios.title_en: UCP #794 Checkout REST Signed Request ucp-agent Covered-Component Gate
scenarios.title_zh: UCP #794 结账 REST 签名请求 ucp-agent 签名覆盖组件门禁
scenarios.detail: Signed UCP REST request omits mandatory covered components: base=[], conditional_headers=['ucp-agent'].

scenarios.title_en: UCP #641 Out-of-Session Payment Collection (Order render_artifact + collection_status) Gate
scenarios.title_zh: UCP #641 会话外支付归集（订单 render_artifact 与 collection_status）门禁
scenarios.detail: Instrument awaiting_payment requires a non-expired dev.ucp.common.payment.render_artifact action on Order.

scenarios.title_en: UCP #489 Variable-Yield Catch-Weight Tolerance & Programmable Authorization Hold Gate
scenarios.title_zh: UCP #489 非定重商品（Catch-Weight）公差与可编程预授权冻结门禁
scenarios.detail: Catch-weight invariant violated: weight_ok=False, amount_ok=False, hold_ok=False.

scenarios.title_en: UCP #668/#649 OpenAPI 3.1.0 securitySchemes & update_checkout checkout.id Omit Gate
scenarios.title_zh: UCP #668/#649 OpenAPI 3.1.0 securitySchemes 与 update_checkout 请求体 id 剔除门禁
scenarios.detail: OpenAPI 3.1.0 prohibits 'in: header, name: Authorization' (must use securitySchemes) and update_checkout must omit/readOnly checkout.id in requestBody.

scenarios.title_en: x402 #3810/#3657 HEAD Payment Settlement Prohibition & HTTP Method Eligibility Gate
scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3810/#3657 HEAD 请求扣款结算禁止与 HTTP 方法支付资格一致性门禁
scenarios.detail: RFC 9110 §9.3.2 HEAD responses cannot carry a body; settling a payment on HEAD charges the buyer for zero content (#3810).

scenarios.title_en: x402 #3803 PAYMENT-REQUIRED Base64 Header Budget Gate (aiohttp 8 KB / Undici 16 KB)
scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3803 PAYMENT-REQUIRED 响应头大小预算（aiohttp 8KB / Undici 16KB）门禁
scenarios.detail: PAYMENT-REQUIRED header is 12188 bytes (exceeds 7168-byte budget; aiohttp limit=8190, Node undici limit=16384).

scenarios.title_en: x402 #3814 Axios Streaming 402 Intermediate Body Drain & Socket Deadlock Gate
scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3814 Axios 流式响应中间 402 响应体排空与连接池死锁阻断门禁
scenarios.detail: Unconsumed intermediate 402 stream with responseType='stream' (maxSockets=1) blocks keep-alive socket reuse and queues paid retry indefinitely (#3814).

scenarios.title_en: x402 #3747 RFC 9111 Quote-Aware Cache-Control: private Directive Parser Gate
scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3747 RFC 9111 引号感知 Cache-Control: private 指令解析门禁
scenarios.detail: Cache-Control header lacks an unquoted top-level 'private' directive or retains 'public': parsed_directives=['public', 'max-age=60', 'example="a, private, b"'].

scenarios.title_en: x402 #3755 payee-name Extension Owner-Signed ENS Origin & Multi-Chain payTo Binding Gate
scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3755 payee-name 扩展 ENS 签名源站与多链 payTo 绑定门禁
scenarios.detail: Request origin 'https://spoof-weather.example.com' is not listed in ENS org.x402.origins for 'weather.example.eth'.

scenarios.title_en: x402 #3693 ext-delegation Principal-Signed JWS Agent Spend Grant & Scope Gate
scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3693 ext-delegation 委托人签名 JWS 智能体支出授权与范围门禁
scenarios.detail: ext-delegation grant check failed: jws=True, signer_ok=False, audience_ok=True, asset_ok=True, amount_ok=False, fresh_ok=True.

scenarios.title_en: x402 #3792/#3779 Python Async Bazaar _get_async_client() & Non-200 Error Body Gate
scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3792/#3779 Python 异步 Bazaar _get_async_client() 与非 200 错误体保留门禁
scenarios.detail: Python x402 facilitator violation: wrong_client_getter=True (#3792), dropped_non200_body=True (#3779).

scenarios.title_en: x402 #3650/#3680/#3811 Go Hook Error Propagation, Paid HTTP Status & Fastify Plain Body Gate
scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3650/#3680/#3811 Go 钩子错误传递、付费响应状态码与 Fastify 纯文本响应门禁
scenarios.detail: x402 lifecycle bug detected: hook_swallowed=True (#3650), upfront_blind_5xx=True (#3680), plain_json_encoded=True (#3811).

scenarios.title_en: x402 #3750/#3660 Per-Call PaymentPayloadContext.request & Non-Vacuous Multi-Rail Amount Law
scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3750/#3660 逐调用 PaymentPayloadContext.request 绑定与多链非零金额法则门禁
scenarios.detail: Per-call request binding or multi-rail amount law violated: context_mismatch=True (#3750), invalid_rails=[{'network': 'solana:mainnet', 'maxAmountRequired': 0, 'usdEquivalentMinor': 0, 'drift_bps': 10000}] (#3660).

scenarios.title_en: MCP #3238/#3226 Dialect-Agnostic inputSchema vs Form requestedSchema & Template list_changed Gate
scenarios.title_zh: MCP #3238/#3226 inputSchema 方言解耦、requestedSchema 表单锁定与模板变更通知门禁
scenarios.detail: MCP schema/notification invariant violated: unsupported_input_dialect=True, requested_has_dialect_override=True, requested_has_nested_non_primitive=True (#3238), template_sync_broken=True (#3226).

scenarios.title_en: tau2-bench #654/#477 Content-Addressed Target DB Hash Cache & user_scenario.persona Typo Gate
scenarios.title_zh: tau2-bench #654/#477 内容寻址目标库哈希缓存与 user_scenario.persona 拼写校验门禁
scenarios.detail: tau2-bench target DB cache or user_scenario schema violation: stale_cache_hit=True (#654), unknown_keys=['persoca'], missing_persona=True (#477).

scenarios.title_en: tau2-bench #154/#474/#430 Concurrent default_vpn_details Deep-Copy, Judge LLM & Str-Num Gate
scenarios.title_zh: tau2-bench #154/#474/#430 并发 VPN 状态深拷贝、评测模型预检与数值字符串强转门禁
scenarios.detail: tau2-bench reliability violation: shares_class_level_mutable_ref=True (#154), unsafe_judge_config=True (#474), inconsistent_str_num_rejection=True (#430).
